verdict.rationale: Otter ships automations, such as auto-joining meetings, pushing action items to CRMs, Jira and Zendesk, and Zapier, API and webhook integrations. Asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is therefore a fair question. The evidence pack contains nothing on versioning, change review, or rollback of automation configurations. Account-level audit trails and activity logs cover something adjacent but different, so they earn no credit.
